text_block_list.text: While walking in front of the station, I saw a tourist from overseas looking troubled, so I approached to help.
However, flustered as they were, they spoke so fast that I couldn't catch what they said. Just as I was at a loss...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Looks like they want directions to their hotel?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for cutting in.
You looked like you were in trouble, so I just couldn't help myself.
choice_data_list: You could actually understand that English just now?!
You could actually understand that English just now?!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I happened to be studying English just now!
By the way, would it be alright if I helped show them the way too?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Seeing you face adversity head-on just made me want to cheer you on!
choice_data_list: Well then, I'm counting on you.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...And then you will
see the hotel on your right.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Okay now, have a good day!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
choice_data_list: Thanks, you really helped me out.
I wish I could speak English too.
If only I could speak English too...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
choice_data_list: Thanks, you really helped me out.
I wish I could speak English too.
If only I could speak English too...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I think that's how those people
feel about you.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I only spoke a little bit toward the end.
You were the one who tried to help first, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I think you, being so supportive in an unfamiliar country, were much more helpful to them!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Well then, have a wonderful day!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Once you just resolve yourself to do it,
you'd be surprised how often things just work out!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I hereby declare: I will master English conversation!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...If you just assert it like that, all that's left is to charge straight ahead!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I always do it this way!
Give it a try if you'd like!
